stb single-file libraries, vendored for N2 native image decode/encode.

Upstream:   https://github.com/nothings/stb
Commit:     4e9b368bfc071e97206ea5c6adba68dd0cbf8897
Files:      stb_image.h        v2.30  sha256 594c2fe35d49488b4382dbfaec8f98366defca819d916ac95becf3e75f4200b3
            stb_image_write.h  v1.16  sha256 cbd5f0ad7a9cf4468affb36354a1d2338034f2c12473cf1a8e32053cb6914a05
            LICENSE                   sha256 bebfe904b14301657e4e5d655c811d51fd31b97c455b9cc2d8600d6bac6cff63
License:    MIT or public domain (dual, see LICENSE)

Justification: the N1 bake intentionally keeps original PNG (lightmaps, world atlas)
and JPEG (Bastion kit textures) payloads. The runtime needs a decoder for both.
Only PNG and JPEG decoding are compiled (STBI_ONLY_PNG, STBI_ONLY_JPEG). PNG writing is
used for frame captures. The files are unmodified; they are compiled in one translation
unit (src/image_codec.cpp) without the project's strict warning flags.

JPEG note: stb_image's IDCT/upsampling is not bit-identical to the browser's libjpeg-turbo
decoder; kit texels may differ by small amounts from the legacy WebGL build.

N7 additions (same upstream commit 4e9b368bfc071e97206ea5c6adba68dd0cbf8897):
            stb_vorbis.c       v1.22  sha256 4c7cb2ff1f7011e9d67950446b7eb9ca044f2e464d76bfbb0b84dd2e23e65636
            stb_truetype.h     v1.26  sha256 ecd30b05e0dd4fea3a13c26810dd9e1992dc379049482c393d5a19e6b5090aab
Justification: the legacy sample bank is Ogg Vorbis (48 samples, decoded at load, src/audio_codec.cpp);
the UI text is rendered from signed-distance glyphs that stb_truetype rasterizes at start from the
shipped fonts (src/ui_font.cpp). Unmodified, compiled without the strict warning flags.
